data.value: The matchmaker is skipped entirely when launching one of these places, even while enabled globally.

data.name: Menu.Overlays.Description
data.value: A small GPU-composited overlay drawn on top of the Roblox window while you're in a game.

data.name: Menu.Overlays.ShowFps.Description
data.value: Draws a small FPS readout in the corner of the Roblox window.

data.name: Menu.Overlays.Diagnostics.Description
data.value: Keeps track of overlay windows so the compositor doesn't hide itself behind its own UI, and powers the diagnostics report.

data.name: Menu.Overlays.CrosshairEnabled.Description
data.value: Draws a crosshair centered on the Roblox window while you're in a game.

data.name: Menu.GameChat.Description
data.value: An in-game chat overlay window that sits on top of Roblox.

data.name: Menu.GameChat.KeyboardHookNotice
data.value: This installs a system-wide low-level keyboard hook while a game session is active (needed so the overlay can be toggled/typed into without stealing focus from Roblox), so it is off by default.

data.name: Menu.GameChat.Enabled.Description
data.value: Toggles the chat overlay and its keyboard hook for the current and future Roblox sessions.

data.name: Menu.GameChat.ServerUrl.Description
data.value: Optional. Cross-player chat is relayed through a server you (or your server admin) configure here - PhasmaStrap does not run a chat server of its own. Leave blank to use the overlay locally (commands like /help, /clear, /console still work) without connecting anywhere.

data.name: Menu.GameChat.MessageFilter.Description
data.value: How aggressively to hide messages flagged by the chat server's moderation scores, if it reports any.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.Description
data.value: GPU shader post-processing (RiShade) applied over the Roblox window as a desktop-duplication overlay. Intended for screenshots, not sustained gameplay - it costs extra GPU time every frame.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.Enable.Description
data.value: Master toggle. Off by default - only takes effect the next time you join a game.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.Preset.Description
data.value: Applies a bundle of effect settings below. Pick Vanilla to reset everything off.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.RenderScale.Description
data.value: Renders effects at a lower resolution and upscales, for extra headroom.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.CustomEffects
data.value: Custom effects: drop raw HLSL pixel shaders (entry point PSCustom, scene texture on t0) into the Integrations\RiShade\Effects folder and they'll be compiled and chained in automatically.

data.name: Menu.RiShade.NotPorted
data.value: Not ported from Voidstrap: depth of field, screen space reflections, ambient occlusion, global illumination, fog, eye adaptation, ReShade .fx preset importing, and the in-game F8 tweak panel. Capture uses desktop duplication rather than per-window Windows.Graphics.Capture, since that needs a CsWinRT projection toolchain this project doesn't have wired up.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.Description
data.value: Driver-level NVIDIA tweaks applied to a dedicated Roblox profile via NVAPI, separate from Roblox's own FastFlags or in-game settings. NVIDIA GPU required.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.Unavailable.Title
data.value: NVIDIA GPU or driver not detected

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.LowLatencyMode.Description
data.value: NVIDIA Reflex-style control panel setting that reduces input latency by limiting how far ahead the CPU can queue rendered frames.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.FrlLowLatencyMode.Description
data.value: Couples the frame rate limiter below to the driver's low-latency frame pacing path.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.FrameRateLimit.Description
data.value: Driver-level frame cap for Roblox, in FPS. 0 leaves it uncapped.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.BackgroundFrameRateLimit.Description
data.value: Separate driver-level FPS cap applied only while Roblox is unfocused/minimized. 0 leaves it uncapped.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.ResizableBar.Description
data.value: Lets the CPU access the entire GPU memory range at once instead of in small windows, if your system supports it.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.DlssSuperResolution.Description
data.value: Forces the driver-level DLSS Super Resolution override on, independent of Roblox's own graphics settings.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.DlssFrameGeneration.Description
data.value: Forces the driver-level DLSS Frame Generation override on.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.Mfaa.Description
data.value: Multi-Frame sampled Anti-Aliasing, a driver-level AA technique layered on top of whatever AA Roblox itself applies.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.Fxaa.Description
data.value: Driver-level Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing, applied as a post-process pass regardless of Roblox's in-game AA setting.

data.name: Menu.Nvidia.GammaCorrection.Description
data.value: Applies gamma-correct antialiasing/blending at the driver level for more accurate colors during AA.

data.name: Menu.ClassicClient.Description
data.value: Runs a private Roblox server on your own machine and points classic/legacy Roblox clients at it, by redirecting roblox.com to 127.0.0.1 in the Windows hosts file for the duration of a classic session. This is a significant change to how your machine resolves Roblox's real domain, so it is off by default and the redirect is only ever active while a classic client session is running.

data.name: Menu.ClassicClient.Enabled.Description
data.value: Master switch for this feature. Must be turned on before a classic client can be launched through PhasmaStrap.

data.name: Menu.ClassicClient.InstallLocation.PlaceholderText
data.value: Leave blank to use the default location

data.name: Menu.ClassicClient.AcquireClients.Description
data.value: Downloads the engine data pack and classic client archives from a third-party GitHub release (not built or hosted by PhasmaStrap - see the code comment on ClassicClients.DefaultBaseUrl). Every download is verified against that release's own published SHA-256 digest before it is extracted.

data.name: Menu.ClassicClient.UpdateAll
data.value: Update engine, maps and installed clients

data.name: Menu.ServerBrowser.Matchmaker.Description
data.value: Before joining a game, probes a batch of its public servers using your real Roblox session and picks the one estimated to have the lowest ping, instead of letting Roblox assign one at random. This reads your Roblox login session from disk and makes real join-attempt calls to Roblox's servers to do that.

data.name: Menu.Performance.RuntimeOptimizer.Description
data.value: Live tuning of the running Roblox process while a game session is active, separate from Roblox's own settings.

data.name: Menu.Performance.OptimizeRoblox.Description
data.value: Raises Roblox's process priority and enables priority boost while it's running.

data.name: Menu.Performance.RobloxEfficiencyMode.Description
data.value: Drops Roblox to idle priority while you're tabbed away from it.

data.name: Menu.Performance.ReduceMemoryOutOfFocus.Description
data.value: Lowers Roblox's priority and periodically trims its working set while you're tabbed away from it.

data.name: Menu.Performance.CpuPriority.Description
data.value: Restricts Roblox to a set number of logical processors via CPU affinity. Automatic uses every available processor.

data.name: Menu.Performance.RobloxPriorityLimit.Description
data.value: The Windows process priority class Roblox should run at.

data.name: Menu.Performance.LauncherMemoryManager.Title
data.value: Reduce PhasmaStrap's own memory usage when idle

data.name: Menu.Performance.LauncherMemoryManager.Description
data.value: Tiered memory-pressure management for PhasmaStrap's own process (not Roblox's) while it's backgrounded, escalating to a deeper trim the longer it stays idle.

data.name: Menu.Performance.SoftwareRendering.Description
data.value: Disables GPU-accelerated rendering for PhasmaStrap's own windows. Useful if you're seeing rendering glitches or crashes related to your graphics driver.

data.name: Menu.Performance.SystemBoost.Description
data.value: These don't touch a single Roblox FastFlag - they change how Windows itself treats the Roblox process, which is where a lot of the FPS gap on laptops and background-heavy PCs actually comes from.

data.name: Menu.Performance.ForceHighPerformanceGpu.Description
data.value: On laptops with both an integrated and a dedicated GPU, pins Roblox to the dedicated one. Windows sometimes runs Roblox on the weaker integrated GPU by default since it isn't recognized as a full-screen game.

data.name: Menu.Performance.DisableGameDVR.Title
data.value: Disable Game Bar / Game DVR for Roblox

data.name: Menu.Performance.DisableGameDVR.Description
data.value: Stops Xbox Game Bar's background recording from hooking into Roblox, which costs some FPS and can add input latency even when you never open the overlay.

data.name: Menu.Performance.BoostTimerResolution.Description
data.value: Raises the system timer resolution while you're in a game, the same trick most FPS-unlocker tools use to reduce stutter and frame-time inconsistency. Small effect, no downside beyond marginally higher power use.

data.name: Menu.Performance.UseHighPerformancePowerPlan.Title
data.value: Use High performance power plan in-game

data.name: Menu.Performance.UseHighPerformancePowerPlan.Description
data.value: Switches Windows to the High performance power plan while playing and restores your previous plan afterward. Matters most on laptops, where the default Balanced plan throttles CPU boost clocks.

data.name: Menu.Performance.Display.Description
data.value: Force Roblox to run at a specific display resolution and refresh rate, and identify your connected monitors.

data.name: Menu.Performance.ForceInGameResolution.Title

data.name: Menu.Performance.ForceInGameResolution.Description
